window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes lagged; South America and military counter-narcotics searches turned up nothing new and verifiable, so those sections are empty. The New Mexico case was announced 3 November.

stories.headline: Albuquerque raid yields roughly 51 kg of fentanyl, the biggest powder seizure in DEA New Mexico history, and a newly hired state paralegal is held
stories.body: Agents searching a northwest Albuquerque home on 29 October recovered about 44 kg of fentanyl powder, over 7 kg of fentanyl pills, some heroin and around 29 firearms. Angel Ramirez, 45, hired by the state Department of Justice on 13 October, was charged federally with fentanyl trafficking and a firearms offense and ordered detained; the case was announced 3 November and involved DEA, FBI, IRS, Homeland Security and local sheriffs.

stories.headline: Punjab police say a drone-dropped 36 kg heroin consignment near the Pakistan border led to four arrests
stories.body: Amritsar's Counter Intelligence unit retrieved the heroin in the Lopoke border area and stopped the suspects, one of them a juvenile, near the Bharatmala Highway bridge, also impounding two motorcycles. Police say a foreign-based handler ran the operation; a case was filed under India's NDPS Act, and reporting dated 6 November.
